name: Sierra Interactive
description: Sierra Interactive is a real-estate platform combining IDX websites, CRM, lead routing, automated follow-up, communications, dialer, reporting and team workflows.
agentUseSummary: Sierra Interactive is visible as a security-review preview. Relay will not collect its account API key until Sierra approves a least-privilege third-party authorization and immutable account-binding contract.

capabilities.label: Review bounded Sierra integration access
capabilities.description: If Sierra approves a least-privilege contract, expose only exact-account, privacy-redacted tools after security review.

blocked.label: Capture a Sierra API key
blocked.description: Relay will not request the broad account API key generated in Sierra's Integrations Manager for this preview.

blocked.label: Read private Sierra CRM data
blocked.description: Leads, contacts, preferences, activity, communications, notes, routing, transactions, users and analytics are unavailable.

blocked.label: Change records or contact leads
blocked.description: CRM writes, routing, action plans, bulk actions, email, SMS, calls, voicemail, ads and other external actions are unavailable.

blocked.label: Run Sierra actions before security review
blocked.description: No Sierra tool is callable until Sierra approves authentication, granular scopes, immutable account and role binding, lifecycle, limits, audit identifiers and distribution terms.

approvalProfiles.label: Sierra API-key security review
approvalProfiles.description: Connection, installation and agent actions remain unavailable because Sierra's API key can reach core CRM data without a public granular-scope lifecycle.

runtimeSupport.description: No OpenClaw tools are callable under Sierra's documented broad API-key contract.
No Hermes tools are callable under Sierra's documented broad API-key contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Sierra lets a customer generate an API key in its account-level Integrations Manager and describes an open API reaching most core CRM functions. Public materials do not establish granular scopes, immutable account and user-role claims, expiration, routine rotation, revocation, stable limits or general third-party distribution approval; public integrations require provider review.
providerSetup.nextAction: Ask Sierra Interactive to approve Relay as a production third-party integration and provide exact authentication, endpoint and schema contracts, granular read scopes, immutable account and role claims, key expiration, rotation and revocation, limits, audit identifiers and distribution terms. Re-run privacy and security review before implementing typed bounded tools.

evidence.supports: Sierra documents generating a customer API key in the Integrations Manager, notes plan-dependent access, and requires public integration providers to contact Sierra for review.
Sierra describes account-level direct API integrations as powerful two-way bridges for lead and CRM synchronization, with each integration configured once per account.
Sierra's CRM spans private leads, behavior-triggered workflows, routing, communications, dialer, reporting, bulk actions and team operations.
Sierra's privacy policy covers contact information, communications, transaction-related data and consent-sensitive outreach, requiring strict least privilege and redaction.
Sierra's terms assign responsibility for lawful contact data and communications and require permission for service access; Relay must not infer unpublished API distribution rights.
